description:
Activate Nantuko Elder by tapping it, adding at least {C}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Nantuko Elder.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Nantuko Elder.
Repeat.
